source.sqlite_access: URI mode=ro; query_only; one read transaction
source.collection: Previously saved homenet check/path/ipv6/capacity/bloat results; no new measurement during export
source.record_kind: Per-run summary statistics, not original packet timing samples
source.ipv6_record_semantics: Legacy IPv6 fails/no IPv6 address labels are preserved as TCP failure/unclassified no-address outcomes respectively. Newer explicit lookup/TCP/no-probes labels are also recognized without publishing exception text.

window.timezone_conversion: Explicit EDT offset for this October 2026 window; independent of host timezone

rules.baseline: Sorted mean-of-available-target p50 values at zero-based floor(n*0.1), matching current episode rule
rules.episode_end: Last slow sample; confirmation occurs after two subsequent non-slow samples
rules.protocols: Gateway uses ICMP echo; internet uses TCP connects; probes are neither simultaneous nor interchangeable
rules.ipv6_missing_outcome: Any target has IPv4 p50 but no usable IPv6 result: explicit TCP/lookup outcome, or legacy/unclassified result for a historically probed target. No-probes records are excluded.

measurement_semantics.download: Application payload bytes read by this client divided by phase duration
measurement_semantics.upload: Client-side payload generation/send estimate divided by phase duration; remote receiver goodput is not measured
measurement_semantics.missing: Failed/unavailable measurement remains null, never zero Mbps

limitations: Observed plateau and IPv6 outcomes are correlated; no cause or home repair is confirmed.
Legacy no IPv6 address conflates no usable AAAA resolution with other resolver outcomes; it does not establish DNS failure.
No capacity runs fall within the detected episodes; outside medians cannot identify saturated direction or device.
Home upload estimates are client-side payload counts, not receiver-confirmed goodput or provisioned line capacity.
Gateway tails and loss mean low medians do not rule out local wireless/router/host effects.
Trace segment attribution is a probe heuristic, not proof of a physical queue location or ISP fault.
A single host/connection, sequential protocols and small per-check samples do not measure real call quality.

privacy.target_identifiers: Opaque aliases only; alias mapping is not exported
